Section 2. Definitions
An immunocompromised host is defined here purely as a string used to check that a
word broken across a line was rejoined. A beta-lactam is the opposite case: that hyphen is part of the term and must survive.

number a reader would see, and that the chunker recorded a span rather than a single page
when a passage runs over a page break.
